1992-2002 reaches the mask through that cell-selection condition. Separately, the threshold pools themselves are read from ext_all with a row-order mismatch (C8 put the 2003 rows before the base rows, so base rows are 5 days early) and C15 uses a leap-aware doy, so the percentile pools that actually feed the smoothed thresholds used for Jun-Aug 2015 cover only about May 6-Sep 14 of each baseline year; the full-year credit comes from the sea-cell selection."}
